candidates.content_angle: Explains Article 22 of Law 36/2024/QH15 (slow down and give way when approaching an intersection: side roads give way to main roads, give way to vehicles from the right at intersections without a roundabout sign and to vehicles from the left at signed roundabouts) and the Decree 168/2024 fines in Article 7(1)(đ) (200,000 to 400,000 VND) and Article 7(6)(c) and (d) (2,000,000 to 3,000,000 VND plus 2 licence points under Article 7(13)(a)).
